newsitem.title: UK: BT $1.0 billion bond due Tuesday - dealers.
newsitem.headline: BT $1.0 billion bond due Tuesday - dealers.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc is expected to issue a $1.0 billion five-year Eurobond on Tuesday, syndicate managers said on Monday.
"The BT issue is expected on Tuesday," a dealer familiar with the transaction said.
Spread talk was around 15 basis points over U.S. Treasury notes, he said.
Earlier, SBC Warburg announced BT would launch the deal via SBC and Merrill Lynch.
BT lost its AAA Moody's Investors Service rating in mid-February and is not rated Aa1. Its AAA long-term debt rating from Standard & Poor's is under review for possible downgrade.
These revisions followed BT's decision last November to merge with MCI Communications Corp, the second largest U.S. long-distance operator.
Bankers said the bond issue was likely to be well-received.
"BT is a fantastic name, even though it is no longer a AAA credit," a U.S. bank trader said, adding investors understood the strategic value of the merger with MCI.
"At around 15 b.p. over Treasuries, the pricing looks attractive and we expect a lot of institutional buying."
